svg.aria-label: Three panels. Left, a ring of three genes each repressing the next. Centre, the three protein concentrations oscillating in a steady out-of-phase rhythm. Right, two phase-plane projections: below the Hopf threshold a trajectory spirals into the fixed point, above it a trajectory spirals outward onto a closed limit cycle.
